cards.ex: We really bonded over our love of hiking.
cards.exUz: Biz piyoda sayr qilishga bo'lgan muhabbatimiz tufayli juda bog'lanib qoldik.
cards.uzDef: Umumiy qiziqishlar orqali do'stlashmoq yoki aloqa o'rnatmoq.

cards.ex: They met last week and they're getting on like a house on fire!
cards.exUz: Ular o'tgan hafta uchrashishdi va juda tez do'stlashib ketishdi!
cards.term: get on like a house on fire
cards.uzDef: Juda tez va yaxshi do'stlashib ketmoq.

cards.ex: They had a big argument, but they're trying to patch things up.
cards.exUz: Ularning janjali katta bo'ldi, lekin ular yarashishga harakat qilyapti.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlardagi muammolarni hal qilib, yarashib olmoq.

cards.ex: I know I can always be there for my friends.
cards.exUz: Men doim do'stlarim uchun yordam bera olishimni bilaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qiyin paytlarda qo'llab-quvvatlamoq.

cards.ex: She's a real people person, always making new friends.
cards.exUz: U juda kirishimli, doim yangi do'stlar orttiryapti.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan oson til topisha oladigan odam.

cards.ex: I tried to mingle with the guests at the party.
cards.exUz: Men ziyofatda mehmonlar bilan aralashishga harakat qildim.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar bilan aralashib, suhbatlashmoq, ayniqsa tadbirda.

cards.ex: It's important to network with other professionals in your field.
cards.exUz: Sohangizdagi boshqa mutaxassislar bilan aloqa o'rnatish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Professional aloqalar o'rnatish uchun odamlar bilan tanishmoq.

cards.ex: I really clicked with her when we met at the conference.
cards.exUz: Konferensiyada uchrashganimizda biz juda mos tushdik.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan tezda yaxshi munosabat o'rnatmoq.

cards.ex: It takes time to open up to someone you just met.
cards.exUz: Yangi tanishgan odamingizga sir ochishga vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ulari va fikrlarini boshqalarga aytmoq.

cards.ex: I've always looked up to my older sister.
cards.exUz: Men har doim opamni hurmat qilganman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir hurmat qilmoq va o'rnak deb bilmoq.

cards.ex: We're having a social gathering next weekend.
cards.exUz: Biz kelasi hafta oxirida tadbir o'tkazamiz.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar birga vaqt o'tkazish uchun yig'iladigan tadbir.

cards.ex: She made me feel at ease right away.
cards.exUz: U meni darhol o'zimni erkin his qilishga majbur qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini qulay va xotirjam his qilmoq.

cards.ex: It takes time to really get to know someone.
cards.exUz: Kimnidir haqiqatan ham bilish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yaxshiroq bilishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I really value their friendship and support.
cards.exUz: Men ularning do'stligini va qo'llab-quvvatlashini juda qadrlayman.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlikni juda muhim deb bilmoq.

cards.ex: Having a common interest helps build strong relationships.
cards.exUz: Umumiy qiziqish kuchli munosabatlar o'rnatishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki yoki undan ortiq odamni qiziqtiradigan narsa.

cards.ex: They share a close bond, having grown up together.
cards.exUz: Ular birga ulg'ayganlari uchun yaqin aloqaga ega.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar orasidagi kuchli va yaqin munosabat.

cards.ex: He tends to keep people at arm's length until he trusts them.
cards.exUz: U odamlarga ishonmaguncha ulardan uzoqlashishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan yaqin munosabatda bo'lmaslikka harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Despite the divorce, they're still on good terms.
cards.exUz: Ajrashganlariga qaramay, ular hali ham yaxshi munosabatda.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan do'stona munosabatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Don't hesitate to reach out to me if you need anything.
cards.exUz: Agar biron narsa kerak bo'lsa, menga murojaat qilishdan tortinmang.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan aloqa o'rnatmoq, yordam taklif qilmoq.

cards.ex: It's great to have a supportive friend in times of trouble.
cards.exUz: Qiyin paytlarda qo'llovchi do'stga ega bo'lish juda yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Har doim yordam berishga tayyor do'st.

cards.ex: We have to attend a function for work next week.
cards.exUz: Biz kelasi hafta ish uchun tadbirda qatnashishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy yoki ijtimoiy tadbirda qatnashmoq.

cards.ex: He told a joke to break the ice at the meeting.
cards.exUz: U yig'ilishda muzni eritish uchun hazil aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Notanish odamlar orasidagi noqulaylikni yo'qotmoq.

cards.ex: She has a heart of gold and always helps others.
cards.exUz: Uning qalbi mehribon va doim boshqalarga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Juda mehribon va saxiy inson.

cards.ex: We've been out of touch since college.
cards.exUz: Biz kollejdan beri aloqada emasmiz.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan aloqada bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: Alcohol can sometimes act as a social lubricant.
cards.exUz: Spirtli ichimlik ba'zan ijtimoiy muhitni yumshatuvchi vazifasini bajarishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy vaziyatni osonlashtiradigan narsa (masalan, ichimlik).

cards.ex: We're all in the same boat with this project.
cards.exUz: Biz hammamiz bu loyihada bir ahvoldamiz.
cards.uzDef: Xuddi shunday qiyinchilikka duch kelgan odamlar.

cards.ex: They're like two peas in a pod; they do everything together.
cards.exUz: Ular ikki tomchi suvga o'xshaydi; ular hamma narsani birga qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil xususiyatlarga ega bo'lgan ikki kishi.

cards.ex: She's a real gem; I'm lucky to have her as a friend.
cards.exUz: U juda qimmatbaho; uni do'st sifatida topganimdan baxtiyorman.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi va qimmatli odam.

cards.ex: Try not to burn bridges when you leave a job.
cards.exUz: Ishdan ketayotganda ko'priklarni yoqmaslikka harakat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarni buzmoq, orqaga qaytish yo'lini qoldirmaslik.

cards.ex: They've been on the outs ever since that argument.
cards.exUz: O'sha janjaldan beri ularning munosabatlari buzilgan.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan janjallashib, munosabatlari buzilgan.
